name: apiplatform
description: A Postman-like, privacy-first API development platform with Bring-Your-Own-Model Agent Mode.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @apiplatform/web && npm run build -w @apiplatform/server && npm run build -w @apiplatform/cli
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @apiplatform/server" "npm run dev -w @apiplatform/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @apiplatform/shared && npm run test -w @apiplatform/server && npm run test -w @apiplatform/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @apiplatform/shared && npm run test -w @apiplatform/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @apiplatform/shared && npm run typecheck -w @apiplatform/server && npm run typecheck -w @apiplatform/web && npm run typecheck -w @apiplatform/cli
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @apiplatform/server && npm run lint -w @apiplatform/web && npm run lint -w @apiplatform/cli
